tagline: LOMO取景器相机，1984 年发布
description: LOMO于1984年推出的取景器相机。配备Minitar-1 3 element 32mm 1:2.8。快门速度1/500 second to 2 mins。感光度25-400ASA (some models rated in GOST)。zone focus 0.8, 1.5, 3m or inifinty。

specs.取景器: Frame lines, parallax error, Battery LED, Low light warning LED (shutter below 1/30sec), focus zone indicators.
specs.闪光灯: X-type syncronisation in hotshoe at 1/60. Aperture manually set.
